title: No One Escapes the Dialectic #1
desc:
THE WORLD'S MOST DANGEROUS COMIC BOOK MAGAZINE!

From Pulitzer Prize and National Magazine Award-winning reporter Spencer Ackerman (Waller Vs. WildStorm, Iron Man) comes the next generation of political radicalism in vigilante comics—unafraid to strike back at the deportation machine that threatens the foundations of American freedom!

When agents of the fearsome Special Naturalization Operations (SNO) become themselves hunted by a masked vigilante, a power struggle breaks out inside SNO between the Deep-State old guard and its death-squad vanguard, Gladio Unit!

Who is the masked vigilante calling themselves The Dialectic, posturing as a Marxist force of history? What is their relationship to their community's liberation—and its violent suppression by SNO?

With powerful art by Italian superstar Antonio Fuso(House of Slaughter, G.I. Joe), No One Escapes the Dialectic is an unapologetic, provocative, and boundary-shattering new ongoing comic series for the age of permanent crisis.
